architecture.locationStores: Two independent WordPress and WooCommerce installations; no WordPress Multisite
architecture.theme: Reusable Empire King theme shared by the corporate site and location stores
architecture.commerce: WooCommerce owns product, cart, and checkout behavior on location stores
architecture.durableBusinessLogic: empire-king-deals plugin owns private Deal records/categories, scheduling, eligibility, featured selection, and owner access
architecture.futureCorporateRouting: Shared theme pickup routes and location selector; single-location Deals route directly to their eligible store

seo.home: Corporate brand and discovery Home; prototype implementation, not approved final design
seo.deals: /deals/ is the sole permanent indexable Deals landing page; no public Deal singles, category archives, or sitemap entries

locationRouting.status: Shared Order Gateway supports Home, Blog, Menu Glimpse, and Deals; verified categories and allowlisted Deals campaign parameters

mediaArchitecture.productAndOperationalMedia: CMS-managed WordPress/WooCommerce media; do not hardcode production uploads
mediaArchitecture.temporaryPlaceholders: Clearly identify any temporary development placeholder when one is introduced
mediaArchitecture.mediaCounts: Not established; do not invent counts
mediaArchitecture.dealPromotionalMedia: User-managed WordPress Media Library featured images; no seeded offers or source-controlled promotional artwork
